_comment: Every rpc the Worker calls, classified (#1409, L96). readOnly names are let through the local dev production write guard in lib/supabase.ts; mutating names and any unlisted name are refused there unless ALLOW_PROD_WRITES is set. A web guard (rpc-classification.test.ts) requires every .rpc('name') call in the worker to be on exactly one list and every listed name to be created by a migration; the SQL suite (supabase/tests/buyer_profiles.test.sql) checks the read only names are STABLE or IMMUTABLE in a real database.
